responsibility: This file defines a MIPS-specific interprocedural optimization pass that analyzes whole-program call relationships to decide when old-ABI callers can omit allocating the outgoing argument frame header on the stack. Operating on cgraph nodes and GIMPLE CFGs, it classifies functions by whether their own arguments or callees require the caller-allocated frame area, detects conservative blockers such as varargs, non-register arguments, inline asm, indirect calls, and nonleaf callees, and records the results in MIPS machine_function flags like does_not_use_frame_header, optimize_call_stack, and callers_may_not_allocate_frame for later prologue/epilogue code generation.
